Ivy (Marketing): Quick idea thread 1: instead of traditional keynote + breakouts, run a 'lab carousel' where attendees rotate through 3 short instructor-led stations. Goal: everyone leaves with a usable checklist + a sample benchmark script. Thoughts?
Omar (Host): Lab carousel = neat. We need very tight transitions. Suggest 4x6m stations and a 10m final Q&A.
Keisha (Growth): Carousel helps tagging intent: capture station choices and map to HubSpot fields. Also we can gate the downloadable scripts behind the CTA.
Sam (Product): Product can own two stations: (1) cost profile scavenger hunt; (2) latency knobs you can flip. Rae can demo KV cache tricks.
Rae (Eng): Ill do a live 90s terminal demo showing batching + quantization delta. Will record a fallback clip. Need a reserved rehearsal GPU for that.
Lina (Speaker Ops): Guest confirmed: Chris will run the eval lab. I need 2 slide bullets + a 30s gif from each presenter by Fri COB.
Chris (Guest): Copy that. Ill produce a short gif of the eval harness and 3 talking bullets.
Ivy (Marketing): Draft run-of-show (all times PT):
```
09:00 - Welcome + orientation (Omar) - 3m
09:03 - Rapid context: production inference tradeoffs - 5m (Ivy + Sam)
09:08 - Carousel instructions + poll to pick first station - 2m
09:10 - Station A (cost scavenger) - 6m
09:16 - Station B (latency knobs) - 6m
09:22 - Station C (eval litmus) - 6m
09:28 - Second rotation (attendees pick new station) - 12m total (6m each for two stations)
09:40 - Regroup + 10m live Q&A seeded from station questions - 10m
09:50 - CTA: download templates, join Slack backchannel, survey - 10m
```
Omar (Host): Can we shorten the wrap CTA to 5m and push downloads via the follow-up email? attendees hate long post-game.
Keisha (Growth): Agree. 5m CTA + 10m post-event email that contains gated link. Also we should run a 1-question pre-event poll on pain area (cost/latency/accuracy) to bias station examples.
Lina (Speaker Ops): Logistics: carousel via Zoom breakouts + central host stream. Need rotation instructions slide and automated breakout assignment doc. Also plan for a manual join link for folks who get dropped.
Rae (Eng): Zoom breakouts scale poorly. Suggest using breakout rooms for <200 people. If registration >200, we switch to streamed station rooms with chat + small office hours.
Sam (Product): Noted. We'll include an expectation line on the landing page: "Interactive carousel for the first 200 registrants; stream + office hours if larger."
InfraAgent: rehearsal_env provisioned: rwdw-carousel-175500. Recording endpoints and fallback buckets enabled.
Ivy (Marketing): Promo headline draft: "Ship inference improvements: 3 hands-on stations to make your next release cheaper and faster". CTA: "Reserve your station + get the benchmark script".
Keisha (Growth): Add a social blurb with a micro-benchmark stat teaser: "See a 30% cost delta demo live". That drives CTR.
Omar (Host): I'll prep the host script with transition lines to keep cadence tight. Also will collect top station questions live and surface 3 into the Q&A.
Lina (Speaker Ops): Action list: 1) all presenters submit 2-slide bullets + gif by Fri COB; 2) Rae uploads recorded fallback; 3) Keisha maps station picks to HubSpot props; 4) InfraAgent confirms rehearsal times; 5) Omar finalizes host script. Rehearsals: tech check = 1755075600, full-dress = 1755162000.
Rae (Eng): Example demo snippet I plan to use: `./run_bench --model=moss --batch=32 --quantize=int8`
Chris (Guest): Shared. Please send greenroom invite and asset upload link.
Ivy (Marketing): Will do. Final thought: keep the session engineer-friendly (no marketing fluff), lean on screenshots + CLI snippets, and ensure every CTA is a concrete artifact (template, script, checklist). :white_check_mark:
